title: The Final in the Rain
text_content: The rain had been falling since the morning, but nobody wanted to cancel the final match. Kelechi, the captain of the red team, stood on the muddy field and rubbed his hands together. The supporters shouted and waved flags from the sides of the pitch. At halftime, the blue team was winning by one goal, and the red players looked exhausted. Kelechi gathered his teammates and reminded them that a match is never finished until the whistle blows. In the second half, the red team passed the ball carefully and attacked again and again. With three minutes remaining, Efe scored a magnificent goal, and the score was level. The game went to penalties, and the whole crowd became silent. Each player stepped forward, took a deep breath, and aimed for the corner of the net. The last penalty belonged to Kelechi, and everyone could see that his legs were trembling. He closed his eyes for a moment, remembered Papa's advice to stay calm, and kicked the ball. It flew past the goalkeeper and into the net, and the red team won the cup. Afterwards, Kelechi told his teammates that the victory belonged to everybody.
